title: Add Remember Me Option to Authentication Flow
description: Add a remember-me option to the authentication flow that persists the username across reloads without persisting sensitive credentials.
prompt: Add a remember-me option to the authentication flow that persists the username across reloads. You may use any available tools (including registered Engram MCP tools if enabled, or standard search commands) appropriate to your environment. CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTION: Do NOT run npm install or modify package.json or node_modules under any circumstances. VERIFICATION GUIDANCE: When verifying your changes, do NOT run full workspace linters (npm run lint) or interactive test watchers (ng test). To verify, run bounded non-interactive checks: 'npx tsc -p projects/angular-ngrx-material-starter/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit' and 'npx tsc -p projects/angular-ngrx-material-starter/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit'. Ensure all commands are strictly non-interactive and complete promptly.

requirements.description: UI layout contains remember-me checkbox and username input field
requirements.criteria: app.component.html contains remember-me checkbox and username input

requirements.description: Authentication flow implements username persistence restoration logic
requirements.criteria: app.component.ts or auth.effects.ts restores username from localStorage

requirements.description: Security Negative Rule: zero password or token persistence in localStorage
requirements.criteria: No setItem persisting password, token, jwt, or secret

requirements.description: Boundary & Blast Radius: zero edits outside auth/app components or package manifests
requirements.criteria: Only core auth, app component, and en.json touched with zero bulk i18n sprawl
